name: Crimson Clergy

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.summary: Climbs walls and ceilings with no ability check.
traits.text: The clergy can climb difficult surfaces, ceilings included, without an ability check.

traits.name: Self-Loathing
traits.summary: Disadvantage on D20 Tests while it can see its own reflection.
traits.text: A vampire-weakness of the clergy: it makes every D20 Test with Disadvantage while it can see its reflection.

traits.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
traits.summary: Takes 20 Radiant if it starts its turn in sunlight; in sunlight, Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
traits.text: The clergy takes 20 Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight, and while in sunlight it has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks. (Druskenvald has no sun: this fires only against Daylight, Sunbeam and the like.)

actions.name: Consume
actions.summary: +5, reach 5 ft or range 60 ft, 2d6+3 Necrotic; the target's Hit Point maximum drops by the damage and the clergy heals that much.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.summary: Wis, DC 13: Disguise Self and Thaumaturgy at will.
actions.text: Casts with Wisdom (spell save DC 13), needing no Material components. At will: Disguise Self, Thaumaturgy.

bonus_actions.name: Crimson Blessing
bonus_actions.summary: Once a day: casts Bless as a Bonus Action.

summary: A blood-hungry vampiric cultist that drains maximum Hit Points with a touch or from range, blesses its allies and cannot bear the sight of its own reflection.
